status: Candidate, not adopted. Aperture wins measured memory/startup but still has higher calibrated cycle-estimated CPU than VLC.
method: Fresh owned portable profiles, 1280x720 actual video canvas at 96 DPI, D3D11VA, explicit linear scaling, H2641080p30 AAC stereo. One discarded warmup and three measured rounds per variant in rotated order; 30-second CPU/cycle windows after at least ten seconds playback. Same new app EXE in all Aperture variants, original versus experimental FFT/wait DLLs. No builders/profilers during the batch.
cpuMethod: Hardware-specific estimate = process cycle delta / actual elapsed seconds / calibrated invariant-TSC rate * 100, one logical processor. Calibration was measured after the batch on the same boot/CPU. CPUID invariant TSC, five QPC/TSC rate samples and a busy-thread/process counter check passed. Raw cycles and sampled CPU times are preserved. This is not a portable cycles-to-time conversion.
counterFinding: Sampled process CPU times vary substantially more than cycle rates; periodic short work and coarse time accounting can alias. Do not treat legacy CPU-time differences as precise causal performance differences. Preserve historical values and keep this method in a separate protocol.
quality: App and native probe share the explicit bilinear luma/chroma profile, with linear/correct downscaling and sigmoid upscaling disabled. VLC forces D3D11 output, D3D11VA and linear scaling. Matching these controls does not prove every decoded/output pixel is identical. This changes Aperture from its prior higher-order/linear-light defaults; custom MPV configuration can restore those settings.
functional: The guarded min1 library passed 59/59 playback checks. One-run H2641080p30 and HEVC Main10 4K60 screens had identical captures across wait modes and no steady decoder/presentation drops. These screens are not full-player rankings or exhaustive frame-pacing validation.
viewportFinding: Outer 1280x800 windows produced different video areas. The new controller targets 1280x720 canvases; resulting outer sizes are 1296x759 Aperture and 1296x832 VLC, with actual child geometry/DPI retained.
limits: One synthetic H264 fixture and one CPU/GPU machine; not a universal player ranking.
Visible-window latency is not first-frame latency.
Root-process resource counters exclude shared system services. Private bytes are commit, working set is residency, and GPU/CPU accounts must not be added.
Raw sampled CPU times remain available as legacy diagnostics; new primary estimates require the retained hardware calibration.
The lower-level MPV changes are guarded experiments separate from normal recipe provenance. Bundled root DLL remains unchanged.
next: Prototype bounded caching of D3D11 decoder views to remove the remaining per-frame resource/copy cost, then validate quality, resource counters and full-player performance.
